comment: The wasm-lua runtime RNG's contracts run on under wasm-patch@1.0 (paralith-mono feat/wasm-lua-rng: rng@1.0 for ao.resolve over the node's wp_rng_* natives, hyperbeam feat/wasm-patch-rng). The bytes come from PARALITH_MONO's backend/native/wasm-lua/<file>, or WASM_LUA_RUNTIME; deploy.mjs refuses any other hash.
